description: Multivariate diagnostics and primary hypothesis tests for multiple continuous outcomes analyzed simultaneously. Produces multivariate normality (Mardia, Henze-Zirkler), Box's M test, scatterplot matrix, correlation matrix, and one multivariate group comparison (Hotelling's T-squared for 2 groups or one-way MANOVA with all four test statistics for 3+ groups) with partial eta-squared per DV and univariate follow-up ANOVAs. Ends with a recommendation block. Outputs .R and .py scripts with publication-quality plots. Handles group- difference tests on 2+ continuous dependent variables (Hotelling's T², MANOVA, one-way MANOVA). Dimensionality-reduction methods (PCA, factor analysis) and canonical correlation are delegated to vera-data-multivariate-generating.
